title: Creation of bladder assembloids by reconstituting tissue stem cell/tumour cell-derived organoids with multiple stromal components
protocol: Perform every step in the biosafety cabinet.
Prepare two sheets of Parafilm at the size of 1.5 cm x 1.5 cm.
Put the Parafilm sheets in a 100 mm petri dish.
Spray gloves and Parafilm with 70 % ethanol.
Release bladder organoids from Matrigel by pipetting with organoid medium.
Collect released organoids in a new 15 ml tube.
Centrifuge organoids at 1,500 rpm, 4 °C, for 5 min.
Remove supernatant and wash organoids with 1 ml of Advanced DMEM/F12 medium.
Centrifuge again at 1,500 rpm, 4 °C, for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant and add 1-2 ml of DMEM containing 10 % FBS and 1 % penicillin/streptomycin.
Transfer organoids with medium to a 35 mm petri dish on ice.
Prepare MEF cells by centrifuging at 1,500 rpm, 4 °C, for 3 min.
Mix MEF cells (1.5 x 10^6) and HULEC cells (2 x 10^5) in one microcentrifuge tube.
Remove the supernatant from cell pellets on ice.
Add 40 μl Matrigel to each cell pellet (perform on ice).
Plate the mixture containing Matrigel and cells on ice.
Take one organoid only using a pipette set at 4 μl.
Take up to 4 μl of MEF and HULEC mixture.
Mix the MEF and HULEC mixture well before taking it.
Make a Matrigel droplet (containing an organoid, MEF, and HULEC) on a sheet of Parafilm.
Place the organoid in the center of the droplet by gently pipetting the Matrigel droplet.
Repeat steps 6-7 to generate 10 droplets (5 per sheet).
Incubate the droplets at 37°C for 5-10 minutes to solidify the gel.
Remove the droplets from Parafilm using fine forceps and place them in a 12-well version of spinning bioreactor containing pre-warmed assembloid medium (5-7 droplets per well).
Culture the droplets in a spinning bioreactor at 37°C with 5.0% CO2 for two days.
Prepare two sheets of Parafilm, each measuring 1.5 cm x 1.5 cm, and place them in a 100 mm petri dish (spray gloves and Parafilm with 70% ethanol).
Prepare BSMC and HULEC mixture.
Prepare 6 x 10^5 BSMC and 6 x 10^5 HULEC, put together in one microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 1,500 rpm, 4 °C, for 3 min.
Remove the supernatant, add 20 μl Matrigel to cell pellets (perform on ice), plate on ice.
Take out the cultures of bladder organoid with stroma from the incubator using a 20p pipette, and put them on a sheet of Parafilm.
Remove the residual medium from the Parafilm.
Take 2 μl of BSMC and HULEC mixture using 20p pipette, put it on each organoid with stroma to make the layered Matrigel droplet.
Place the organoid with stroma in the center of the droplet by gently pipetting the Matrigel droplet.
Repeat the procedure to generate 10 droplets.
Incubate at 37 °C for 5-10 min to solidify the gel.
Remove the droplets from the Parafilm using a fine forceps, put them in a 12-well version of spinning bioreactor containing 2 ml of pre-warmed assembloid medium.
Spray gloves and Parafilm with 70% ethanol.
Prepare six sheets of Parafilm measuring 1.5 cm x 1.5 cm, place them in a 100 mm petri dish.
Release tumour organoids from a Matrigel drop by pipetting the organoid medium.
Centrifuge released organoids at 1,500 rpm for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend organoids in 1 ml of Advanced DMEM/F12 medium.
Transfer organoids to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Repeat centrifugation at 1,500 rpm for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and add 200 μl of Advanced DMEM/F12 medium, keep on ice.
Prepare CAF cells (7.5 x 10^6).
Prepare HULEC cells (6 x 10^5).
Combine prepared CAF and HULEC with the tumour organoids in the microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 1,500 rpm, 4 °C, for 3 min.
Remove the supernatant and add 150 μl Matrigel on ice.
Mix the Matrigel with the mixture containing tumour organoids, CAF, and HULEC on ice.
Take 5 μl of the mixed solution to make a droplet on Parafilm.
Repeat the procedure to generate 30 droplets, making 5 droplets on each sheet.
Incubate at 37 °C for 5-10 min to solidify the gel.
Remove the droplets from the Parafilm using fine forceps and place them in a 12-well version of spinning bioreactor containing 2 ml pre-warmed assembloid medium.
Culture the droplets in a spinning bioreactor at 37 °C with 5.0 % CO₂ for seven days.
Change the medium every other day during culture.
